description: Teacher pay / зарплата учителя / мұғалім жалақысы. Calculates the monthly salary of a Kazakhstan state-school teacher in 2026 under Government Decree No. 1193 and the Law "On the Status of the Pedagogue": position salary by education and experience, qualification category, class supervision, notebook checking, rural and master-degree supplements, then gross, withholdings (OPV, VOSMS, IPN) and net. Experience, category, curator and notebook options are fixed ids; ask the user which applies and do not guess. experience_id: exp_0 = До 1 года; exp_1_2 = От 1 года до 2 лет; exp_2_3 = От 2 до 3 лет; exp_3_5 = От 3 до 5 лет; exp_5_7 = От 5 до 7 лет; exp_7_10 = От 7 до 10 лет; exp_10_13 = От 10 до 13 лет; exp_13_16 = От 13 до 16 лет; exp_16_20 = От 16 до 20 лет; exp_20_plus = Более 20 лет. category_id: none = Без категории / Педагог; moderator = Педагог-модератор (+30%); expert = Педагог-эксперт (+35%); researcher = Педагог-исследователь (+40%); master = Педагог-мастер (+50%). curator_id: none = Не является классным руководителем; primary = 1–4 классы (50% БДО); secondary = 5–11 классы (60% БДО). notebook_check_id: none = Без проверки тетрадей; primary = 1–4 классы: общее (40% БДО, фиксированная); primary_national_lang = 1–4 классы: казахский/нац. язык в классах с русским яз. (50% БДО); secondary_sciences = 5–11 классы: математика, физика, химия, биология, иностранный язык, черчение (40% БДО); languages_secondary = 5–11 классы: казахский, русский, родные языки и литература (50% БДО).

apply_tax_deduction.description: Apply the base tax deduction of 30 MRP per month. Set false when it is already applied at another tax agent.

curator_id.description: Class supervision supplement id (see tool description). Default "none".

experience_id.description: Work experience bracket id (see tool description).

has_master_degree.description: Has a master degree of a scientific-pedagogical direction: supplement of 10 MRP (Law "On the Status of the Pedagogue" art. 8 p. 5).

is_cabinet_manager.description: Heads a study room, workshop or laboratory: supplement at the calculator's model rate (not confirmed against a primary source, see assumptions).

is_rural.description: Works in a rural area: the calculator applies a 25% supplement (the law sets a minimum of 25%) on pay for hours and the category supplement.

is_small_class.description: Class has fewer than 15 pupils: supervision and notebook supplements are paid at 50%.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

notebook_check_id.description: Notebook and written work checking supplement id (see tool description). Default "none".

standard_hours.description: Standard weekly load that equals one full rate: 16 (general secondary education, default) or 18 (colleges and vocational education; Law "On the Status of the Pedagogue" art. 8 p. 3).

weekly_hours.description: Actual weekly teaching load in hours, 1 to 36.

title: Kazakhstan teacher salary (2026)
